item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E004","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The Federal Court of Auditors reported that the federal budget was strongly expansionary from 2020 to 2024, federal debt grew substantially, interest rates rose, and fiscal room for infrastructure, digitalisation, defence, and climate protection was limited.","notes":["The excerpt states these developments but does not explicitly establish that rising interest costs caused the reduced fiscal room."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E007","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The Federal Court of Auditors identified several federal implementation and oversight failures: the BMDV lacked an owner strategy for Deutsche Bahn after more than 30 years; a €87.5 million 2023 long-distance rail subsidy was launched without the required prior economic assessment and later judged uneconomic; and the BMDV failed to review more than 100 above-tariff Autobahn GmbH contracts, including leadership appointments that were not always publicly advertised and selection decisions that were not documented.","notes":["The excerpt says leadership positions were not always publicly advertised, not that they uniformly lacked adequate public advertising."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E013","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E014","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E015","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0030-E016","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In June 2023 the federal government stated that security authorities continued monitoring Chinese overseas police-station activities in Germany and would not tolerate them; it also demanded Alexei Navalny's immediate release and described his detention as based on a politically motivated judgment, while acknowledging that engagement through the few available channels with Russia was very difficult.","notes":["The excerpt refers to few available channels and the difficulty of engagement; it does not specifically characterize them as channels for obtaining information."]}]}
